findings.title: buyArtworks is payable with no @.value field; on the vault path msg.value is unchecked and lost.
findings.reason: When payByVaultContract is true, the vault pays and nothing checks msg.value, so any ETH the signer sends stays in the contract. The payout only uses saleData_.price, and the screen has no @.value field. 'Price' and 'Pay via vault' are shown, but neither gives the ETH actually sent on this path.
findings.quote: FeralfileArtworkV4_1.sol buyArtworks (external payable): `saleData_.payByVaultContract ? vault.payForSale(r_, s_, v_, saleData_) : require(saleData_.price == msg.value, ...)`; later `uint256 leftOver = saleData_.price - distributedRevenue; payable(costReceiver).transfer(leftOver);`. Descriptor buyArtworks fields: saleData_.price, cost, destination, tokenIds, expiryTime, payByVaultContract, revenueShares, with no `@.value`.

findings.title: startSale permanently disables minting, and the intent does not say so.
findings.reason: In this contract, closing minting is the precondition of selling: resumeSale and pauseSale both require !mintable. 'Start artwork sale' means the switch from the mint phase to the sale phase, so the side effect falls under not_critical #12 (the prerequisite of the stated action). It is an owner-only setting, not an effect on the signer's assets, and at most it rates a warning for the intent wording.
findings.quote: FeralfileArtworkV4.sol startSale: `function startSale() external onlyOwner { mintable = false; resumeSale(); }`; resumeSale: `require(!mintable, "FeralfileExhibitionV4: mintable required to be false");`. Descriptor: `"startSale()": { "intent": "Start artwork sale" }`

findings.title: buyArtworks is payable with no @.value field; on the vault path msg.value is unchecked and lost.
findings.reason: On a successful vault-funded purchase, attached ETH is neither checked nor refunded: distributions total the sale price, leaving the extra ETH in the contract. The displayed price and vault flag do not disclose that additional payment.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x81c882c59799ea442317d020c39174aaaa8d7fc7/src/contracts/FeralfileArtworkV4_1.sol, buyArtworks: `saleData_.payByVaultContract ? vault.payForSale(r_, s_, v_, saleData_) : require(saleData_.price == msg.value, "FeralfileExhibitionV4: invalid payment amount");` and `uint256 leftOver = saleData_.price - distributedRevenue; ... payable(costReceiver).transfer(leftOver);`. descriptor.json, buyArtworks: `"intent": "Purchase artworks"`, `"path": "saleData_.price", "label": "Price"` and `"path": "saleData_.payByVaultContract", "label": "Pay via vault"`; no field displays `@.value`.

findings.title: startSale permanently disables minting, and the intent does not say so.
findings.reason: Disabling ordinary minting is an enforced prerequisite for starting this sale, which the severity guide explicitly excludes from critical findings. Additionally, merging can still mint replacement artworks, so the claim that all minting is permanently disabled is too broad.
